title: Interno
summary: Chats between the people of a work account, on their member identities (bipe ADR 0284 phase B): Geral with everyone, and private direct chats. A row at the top of Conversas of a work account with two or more people opens it. Customers never see it.

phase.description: setup: the member session signs in (bipe_interno_setup). failed shows bipe_interno_error with a retry.

of.description: Geral first, then direct chats newest first.

rooms.description: Rooms of the member identity's session.

of.description: Member user ID and seat name pairs from GET /v1/me/business/members, without me.

people.description: The other people, for the new chat picker.

open.effect: On first open on this device: POST /v1/me/business/members/session, then m.login.password with that user and password on the same homeserver, as a second SDK session under the work account row. The app forgets the password after the sign-in. The session sets up its own cross-signing when the identity has none, and gets no recovery key prompt (Default). Later opens reuse the session.

ensureGeral.effect: When GET members has geral_room_id null and the account has two or more members: create a private, invite-only, encrypted room named with bipe_interno_geral, invite every member, then PUT /v1/me/business/members/geral. 409 geral_exists: leave the new room, join the claimed one. When Geral exists: invite each member that is not in it yet.

userId.description: A member user ID from people.

newChat.effect: Opens the direct chat with that member, or creates it: private, invite only, encrypted, is_direct. bipe_interno_private_hint shows at the top.

openRoom.effect: Opens the room in the normal chat timeline of the member session.

notes: The member session never shows in the account switcher and never counts against maxPersonalAccounts.
The homeserver refuses every invite between a member identity and any other user (bipe ADR 0284 point 8), so the app offers only members.
Push: the member session registers its own pusher, so Interno rings per person. The work account row's notification settings cover it.
When the person leaves Quem atende, bipe-api deactivates the member identity and the session ends.
